thesis: A rejection candle at the 52-week high (31.0) in a broad risk-off tape (VIX percentile 0.995, QQQ below 50/200-day) is a poor moment to start a long swing. The stock fell 5.4% on the highest volume since the spike, with no news to explain it, which looks like distribution into strength. Price sits above the mean analyst target, consensus is Reduce, and the CFO is selling, so the valuation-cheap argument lacks sell-side support. The stop is only about 0.5 ATR from entry, so noise alone can stop out the trade, and 21.7% short interest makes gaps likely in both directions. There is also no scheduled catalyst before about late Feb 2027, so nothing forces a re-rating inside the swing window.
